name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 32 times in 13 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 62 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-04-30, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.80 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
